'''''Squid Lake''''' was a classic zero-[[Gravity/Legends|gravity]] [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] ballet in which performers moved around in several large spheres of shimmering [[Water/Legends|water]]. The ballet's opening night at [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant's]] [[Galaxies Opera House/Legends|Galaxies Opera House]] was performed by the prestigious [[Mon Calamari Ballet]] and took place in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], shortly after the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]]. It was attended by members of [[Coruscanti/Legends|Coruscanti]] elite society, including the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]], [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]].

==Description==
''Squid Lake'' was a [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] ballet<ref name="CSWE Squid Lake" /> which was performed in zero-[[Gravity/Legends|gravity]]<ref name="ROTS novelization">[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (novelization)|''Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith'' novelization]]</ref> [[Repulsor field/Legends|repulsorfields]]<ref name="SWC:TP">''[[Star Wars Chronicles: The Prequels]]''</ref> which projected immense spheres<ref name="ROTS junior novelization">[[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith (junior novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'' junior novelization]]</ref> of shimmering [[Water/Legends|water]].<ref name="ROTS novelization" /> The performers danced from globe to globe while [[Music/Legends|music]] played,<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref> and the performers wore [[Color/Legends|blue]] [[Clothing/Legends|garments]] with a long pink and yellow ribbon extending out from the back of each performer's head.<ref name="SWC:TP" /> The ballet's performance also featured a principal soloist.<ref name="ROTS novelization" />

==History==
Considered a classic by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]],<ref name="SWC:TP" /> the ballet's premiere performance<ref name="CSWE Squid Lake" /> on the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] took place<ref name="CSWE Squid Lake" /> shortly after the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]]<ref name="ROTS" /> in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].<ref name="ROTS date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|III}} to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].</ref> Due to the battle, attendees of a canceled security workshop hosted by Coruscant's [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|security agencies]] were given vouchers to attend events in [[Coruscanti/Legends|Coruscanti]] entertainment, including the premiere of ''Squid Lake''.<ref name="DB Godalhi">{{DB|character|janugodalhi|Godalhi, Janu}}</ref> The performance itself took place in the [[Uscru Entertainment District/Legends|Uscru Entertainment District's]]<ref name="SWC:TP" /> [[Galaxies Opera House/Legends|Galaxies Opera House]],<ref name="CSWE Squid Lake" /> owned by [[Romeo Treblanc]] and considered one of the planet's most renowned theaters during the last [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="CSWE Galaxies">{{CSWECite|I|313|Galaxies Opera House}}</ref> It was performed by the prestigious aquatic dance troupe called the [[Mon Calamari Ballet]],<ref name="CSWE Mon Cal Ballet">{{CSWECite|II|326|Mon Calamari Ballet}}</ref> who engaged in a modern performance of the ballet.<ref name="SWC:TP" /> The event was attended by studied culture lovers,<ref name="CSWE Squid Lake" /> members of Coruscanti high society,<ref name="CSWE Led Daragon">{{CSWECite|I|165|Daragon, Led}}</ref> as well as individuals who attended only to be seen.<ref name="CSWE Squid Lake" />

[[File:Palpatines private viewing box.png|250px|right|thumb|''Squid Lake''{{'}}s Coruscant premiere was attended by Supreme Chancellor Palpatine and other members of Republic government.]]

One attendee of the opening night was [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]],<ref name="ROTS" /> who had helped finance the theater,<ref name="CSWE Galaxies" /> who watched the performance from his [[Palpatine's private viewing box|private box]], alongside [[Vice Chair/Legends|Vice Chair]] [[Mas Amedda/Legends|Mas Amedda]], [[Senior Administrative Aide/Legends|Senior Administrative Aide]] [[Sly Moore/Legends|Sly Moore]],<ref name="ROTS" /> and [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Sweitt Concorkill/Legends|Sweitt Concorkill]].<ref name="I85 Who's Who">{{InsiderCite|85|Who's Who in the Delegation of 2000}}</ref> Palpatine invited [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] to the ballet, telling him the [[Tragedy of Darth Plagueis the Wise/Legends|''Tragedy of Darth Plagueis the Wise'']]<ref name="ROTS" /> as part of his [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] plot<ref name="100 Scenes">''[[Star Wars in 100 Scenes]]''</ref> to turn Skywalker to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]].<ref name="SWI 125">{{InsiderCite|125|Classic Moment|Classic Moment: The Tragedy of Darth Plagueis}}</ref> The event was also attended by the [[Tethan]] constable [[Janu Godalhi/Legends|Janu Godalhi]], who had traveled to Coruscant to attend the ill-fated security workshop, choosing to use his voucher at the [[Opera/Legends|opera]] house, though he left the performance due to its security flaws.<ref name="DB Godalhi" />

Despite Palpatine's apparent appreciation for Mon Calamari culture, after the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the [[Species/Legends|species]] became a target of some of the most brutal [[Speciesism/Legends|speciesism]] during his reign as [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]].<ref name="SWI 125" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|My now-wife and I were going out to dinner and I got a call, which I rarely did, asking me develop ideas for a scene that George wanted to change. He wanted the scene to take place at a ballet or an opera. He said, Think about it being ''Swan Lake'', or ''Squid Lake'' with squid guys. So I was thinking that we could do a space twist on a water ballet and have this giant ball of water in zero-gravity. So I sent these paintings over the next day and they ran with it. Once the paintings got approved, George sent me to Vegas where they have the Cirque du Soleil show ''O''. He sent me to take notes so we could really nail the final look.|Ryan Church|<ref name="AWN">{{WebCite|url=https://www.awn.com/vfxworld/otherworldly-concept-designs-ryan-church|text=Otherworldly Concept Designs of Ryan Church|author=Wollf, Ellen|date=2005-07-13|archivedate=20220514013510}}</ref>}}

[[File:SquidLakeConcept-RyanChurch.jpg|250px|left|thumb|Concept art for ''Squid Lake'' was made by Ryan Church.]]

''Squid Lake'' was first referenced in the "A Night at the Theater" entry in [[Episode III Set Diary]], a [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] feature written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] on [[August 23]], [[2004]].<ref name="Set Diary">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/member/episode-iii/bts/setdiary/news20040823.html|series=Episode III Set Diary|text=A Night at the Theater}}</ref> The ballet first appeared, still unnamed, in the [[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (novelization)|novelization]] of the final film of the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[prequel trilogy]], [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']],<ref name="ROTS" /> released on [[April 2]], [[2005]],<ref name="Cargo Bay">{{RandomHouseOld|url=author/results.pperl?authorid=30059|text=Matthew Woodring Stover}}</ref> and was first named by the [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith Illustrated Screenplay|''Illustrated Screenplay'']]<ref name="ROTS IS" /> which released simultaneously to the novel.<ref name="ROTS IS release date">{{SWArchive|url=episode-iii/release/publishing/news20050308.html|text=Episode III eBooks On Their Way}}</ref> The ballet was then pictured in the theatrical release of ''Revenge of the Sith''<ref name="ROTS" /> on [[May 19]] of that same year.<ref name="Year by Year">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, Updated and Expanded Edition]]''</ref>

Originally, the scene in ''Revenge of the Sith'' where Palpatine tells Anakin Skywalker about [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]] was supposed to take place in the [[Chancellor's Suite/Legends|Chancellor's office]]. However, director [[George Lucas]] felt that there were too many scenes in this locale already.<ref name="Art">''[[The Art of Star Wars Episode III: Revenge of the Sith]]''</ref> Wanting something different for the scene, the director decided to move the locale to a opera house or ballet. Concept artist [[Ryan Church]] came up with the idea of a giant anti-gravity water ball<ref name="AWN" /> and designed the look of the show. Due to the spherical balls of water, the opera house was designed spherical on the exterior<ref name="Art" /> and later took on a 360-degree design, with the opera stage at the center of the theater.<ref name="SW Archives">''[[The Star Wars Archives: Episodes I–III, 1999–2005]]''</ref> Actor [[Ian McDiarmid]], who played Palpatine in ''Revenge of the Sith'',<ref name="ROTS" /> had a previous background in theater which made Pablo Hidalgo believe that the theater setting was fitting.<ref name="Set Diary" />

The name ''Squid Lake'' is a reference to the real-world ballet ''[[Wikipedia:Swan Lake|Swan Lake]]''. The look of the show was partially inspired by the water-themed [[Wikipedia:Cirque du Soleil|Cirque du Soleil]] show ''[[Wikipedia:O (Cirque du Soleil)|O]]'', which Lucas had Church attend and take notes on.<ref name="AWN" />

===Non-canon history===
In the [[2006]] comic ''[[Tag & Bink: Revenge of the Clone Menace]]'', written by [[Kevin Rubio]], the existing ''Revenge of the Sith'' scene featuring ''Squid Lake'' was spoofed with the Mon Calamari ballet dancers replaced by characters from the film [[Wikipedia:Finding Nemo|''Finding Nemo'']].<ref name="Tag & Bink">''[[Tag & Bink: Revenge of the Clone Menace]]''</ref> Later, the [[2013]] non-canon [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Tiny Death Star]]'', developed by [[Disney Mobile]], featured ''Squid Lake'' as a possible performance in the "Galaxies Opera" recreation level on the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star I]] [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]]. In the game, the ballet lasted forty-five minutes and cost 450 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="TDS">''[[Star Wars: Tiny Death Star]]''</ref>
